art_direction.palette_reason: Teal machinery separates from slate service surfaces, coral encodes a schematic comparison and cream preserves hardware and disclosure readability.
art_direction.shape_language: Round fan grilles and fin ribs contrast with the low wheeled inspection sensor and pistol-shaped handheld thermometer.

hero.silhouette: Tall recognizable fan and fin housings contrast with a low mobile sensor and an independently supported pistol-shaped checker.
hero.finish: Visible fin ribs, guard rings, fan hubs, fasteners, feet and pipes surround a broad schematic thermal surface. A large checker aperture and colored result remain legible on a grounded cradle.

lighting.motivation: A restrained ceiling service light shapes dark finished hardware. Unlit disclosed schematic fin and checker surfaces preserve legible coral/teal comparison without claiming a measured thermal image.

art_direction.focal_hierarchy: Broad warm/cool fin comparison leads, followed by a large separate checker result matching the conserved first-unit color. The other transient state and attached open flag provide the limit.
art_direction.motion_language: Short finite checkpoint positioning and thermometer aiming accelerate and brake with contact/travel windows. Held cameras preserve recognition and consequence.

signature_shot.reason: A separate tool checks the same warmer equipment without claiming a robot performs maintenance.

s1.reason: Equipment-only close opening. Conserved finished units occupy the principal picture; remove the unneeded sensor obstruction and complete a broad schematic warm comparison during the first event.

s2.reason: Hold the whole grounded foreground actor and both warm/cool targets across two substantial checkpoint traverses, braking and a conserved return. Camera movement is not the inspection action.

s3.reason: Show a separate large supported checker beside the conserved warm surface.

s4.reason: Keep the full reported warm-to-teal restored state legible.

s5.reason: Show the other transient surface and attached unresolved inspection flag.

s6.reason: Return to the conserved equipment with an open next-check flag.
